description: This file defines synchronization utilities for a plugin-based system, including thread-local flags, mutex management, function wrappers for thread-safe method invocation, and guard classes for managing lock states.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct managing a recursive mutex for each class type to synchronize API calls.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Guard class that unlocks the mutex upon construction if the thread is using a locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: Guard class that manages locking and unlocking of the mutex for a specific class type.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe wrapper around a class method, managing lock acquisition and release.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a class method with the JSONRPC system, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a class method with versioning support, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a class method with a JSONRPC handler, ensuring thread safety.
